(I'm not a mod/creator.) My guess would be that, right now, it can cover just about any branch of self improvement. If/when it gets so popular that things start to get unruly, it would make sense to narrow focus or split into more subverses.

@fancymug is correct. This is currently a subverse about self improvement in general. I'll narrow the focus when/if the times comes based upon what the community wants, if that is what they end up wanting. Until then, feel free to discuss any and all things that might improve your self or your lot in life.

I've noticed that the more I improve in one aspect of my life, another aspects always seems to be lagging and holding the first aspect down. Balance between health, fitness, finance, mind, body, a healthy social life, etc. is so overlooked, but probably one of the most important things to consider for someone who's looking to improve in general. I agree that it might be necessary to niche down in the future, but I think that with our current size we have the unique ability to contribute to this "balance" without getting too overwhelmed with junk and spammy blog posts like these self improvement subs tend to get. Quality over quantity of course, but having more topics allows for more quality posts. Either way, the community dictates what they want via up and down votes; so I'm sure we'll find out what the popular post types are soon and be able to cater towards that a little.
